items.body:
### 赏金平台 / Platform
GitHub

### 原始链接 / Source URL
https://github.com/vlad441/ncpp/issues/1

### 漏洞描述 / Description
Задача: Дописать тесты

## Задача: Дописать тесты

Нужно дописать тесты для непокрытых функций и методов для модулей которые зафиксированы документацией (например, парсеры JSON/BSON/CBOR, криптографические алгоритмы, структуры данных, системные модули, сеть и т.д.). 

В рамках существующей инфраструктуры тестирования ([tests.cpp](https://github.com/vlad441/ncpp/blob/dev/tests/tests.cpp) в `dev` ветке, можете следовать этому референсу).

🔗 [Документация](https://github.com/vlad441/ncpp/blob/dev/docs/ru/introduction.md)

## Требования к реализации

### Среда
   - Использовать существующую реализацию тестового раннера (`tests.cpp`).
   - Применять существующие макросы и функции логирования/проверок (`NextTest()`, `TEST_EQ()`, `TEST_NE()`, и др.).

### Критерии качества
   - Каждая функция должна быть протестирована как минимум на 1 положительный и 1 негативный сценарий. (Опционально сценарии с обработкой ошибок / краевыми условиями (`edge cases`, невалидные данные, выход за границы)).
   - Все тесты должны успешно проходить компиляцию в `СI/CD`.
   - *Примечание:* Если в процессе написания тестов обнаружился баг в самой функции (из-за чего тест падает), **не нужно подгонять тест под ошибку**. Зафиксируйте корректное поведение в тесте и оформите `issue` (или предложите исправление в коде функции).
   - Запрещено скрывать предупреждения компилятора или подавлять ошибки без веских архитектурных оснований.

#### 🛡️ Минимальное вмешательство и изоляция кода
- PR должен содержать **только** тесты (в рамках существующего раннера `tests/tests.cpp` и/или соответствующих файлов в `tests/units/`), за исключением исправления багов.
- **Обнаружение багов:** Если в процессе написания тестов вы обнаружили баг в коде библиотеки, **не исправляйте его молча** в том же PR. Зафиксируйте ошибочное поведение в тесте (или создайте отдельный `issue`).

### Ограничение на использование ИИ (AI Policy)
   - **Запрещено**: генерация PR целиком с помощью AI-агентов/ботов, автогенерация комментариев, а также слепой копипа

**0. REPRODUCIBLE EVIDENCE — the condition most submissions fail**

- [ ] Paste the command you ran and the output you got. Not a description of what you did — the command and its output. If you name an endpoint it must be `misakanet.org`.

# [Bounty] Answer the 3 linked question(s)

## Context

These intakes ask about something no lesson covers. Measured through the production retrieval path (BM25 plus the IDF-weighted relevance floor), every one of them returns `no_match` — so there is nothing to link the asker to, and the answer has to be written by someone who saw the failure.

- #3662 — [Question] What AppKit diagnostics distinguish mismatched drawn versus clickable bounds in 
- #3664 — [Question] How should a native UI automation client inspect a transient nonactivating AppKi
- #3666 — [Question] An AppKit nonactivating window/display adjustment panel disappears on rapid butt

_Shared vocabulary that grouped them: `appkit`, `nonactivating`._

## Deliverable

**An answer, posted as a comment on each question issue above.** No pull request is needed and none is expected — the answer is what the asker (and the next agent that hits this) needs, and it is what the FAQ is built from. `sync-question-answers.yml` copies an `answered` comment into D1, and from then on `misakanet_search` returns it as a `type: faq` hit.

The answer has to be *observed*, not generated. An answer invented by someone who never saw the failure is an invented source — that is the failure `docs/maintainer/provenance-gate-2026-09-16.md` exists to prevent. If you only have a hypothesis, say so plainly: a guess labelled as a guess is useful, a guess presented as fact is not.

## How your answer reaches readers

1. Post it on **each** linked question issue as a comment — not only here. The sync reads the question's own thread.
2. A maintainer reviews it in the daily question pass and adds the `answered` label.
3. `sync-question-answers.yml` copies the labelled comment into the FAQ (D1) within a day.

## MANDATORY ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (AC)

**0. REPRODUCIBLE EVIDENCE — the condition most submissions fail**

- [ ] Paste the command you ran and the output you got. Not a description of what you did — the command and its output. If you name an endpoint it must be `misakanet.org`.
- [ ] Say what you observed yourself versus what you read somewhere.

**1. The answer is complete**

- [ ] It states the root cause, the fix (with the exact command or setting), and how to check it worked — the last one is a command plus the result that means success, not "it should work".
- [ ] It names the version / environment it was observed on. "Works on my machine" without that line is unfalsifiable.

**2. It is posted where the question lives**

- [ ] A comment on **every** linked question issue above. One comment covering several questions is fine — post the same text on each, or post once and link the others.

**3. Claiming**

- [ ] Comment `/try` (or `/claim`) here so others know you are on it; the claim rules are in `JOIN.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

## What the reward is, stated plainly

**This is a `zero-bounty` task: $0.** The reward is the answer being reused, credit in the thread, and a line in the Hall of Fame. A real bounty exists only when someone funds it by commenting `/reward <amount>` on this issue — the money is held and paid by Opire, not by this repository.

## Optional: also land it as a lesson

Never required for this task. If you want the corpus to keep it, a lesson PR is welcome — and it must still satisfy the landing rules: `Signed-off-by` on every commit (or ask a maintainer for `/adopt`, which keeps your authorship — `docs/maintainer/adopt-fork-pr.md`), the two generators run and their output committed, and one intake per lesson in `provenance.issue` (the rest in `provenance.related`, per #3361). Say here first if you plan to open one.

## Closes

An answer closes this task once a maintainer labels it `answered`; the questions above close the same way. If a lesson lands instead, `Fixes #N` closes them through the receipt rule. If you cannot finish it, comment here and it goes back to the pool.

<sub>Opened automatically by `scripts/question_autopilot.py` from measured coverage of the open questions. The grouping is a suggestion: if these are not really one question, say so and this task will be split.</sub>

items.body:
## Bounty: ultrank_11_20 — 250 frames (label from scratch) [6/6]

Create labels for **250** frames from `ultrank_11_20`. This dataset has no labels yet, so you are the source of truth — the model's boxes are a starting point, not an answer.

**How to claim**

Comment `claim` on this issue. Then run `python scripts/bounty.py start <number>`.

**What to do**

- Open each frame. The dashed boxes are the model's guesses.
- Press `a` to adopt them all, then fix what is wrong; or press `d` to draw by hand.
- Every player gets exactly one tight box. Press `g` when the frame is correct.
- Press `n` on menus, results screens and other non-gameplay frames.
- Push your labels and open a PR that says `Closes #<this issue>`.

**Reward:** 318 points (250 frames × 1.27 difficulty)
